title: Stakeholders & CSR Adventure 3: Ethics & Sustainability
welcome_lead: Today you'll explore ethical objectives and sustainability in business strategy.
meta_desc: Business Management: ethical objectives, codes of conduct and sustainability strategies.
final_note: You set ethical objectives and examined sustainable business strategies.

concepts.def: Goal beyond profit, set on principle

walkthroughs.body_html:
Beyond profit, firms may set ethical objectives.

Examples: paying a living wage, sourcing fair-trade, avoiding child labour, donating profits, refusing exploitative ads.

Ethical objectives can clash with short-term profit but build long-term trust and reduce risk.

A code of conduct sets rules for staff and suppliers.

Typical contents: anti-bribery, environmental compliance, whistleblowing, diversity, supplier audits.

Codes work only with training, enforcement and senior support — otherwise they are paperwork.

Brundtland (1987): 'meeting the needs of the present without compromising future generations'.

The circular economy (Ellen MacArthur Foundation) replaces 'take-make-dispose' with reuse and regeneration.

Beware greenwashing — vague claims, selective data, single 'eco' product in a polluting portfolio.

What is a key disadvantage of being a sole trader?
options: Sole traders must employ at least one other person by law.
Unlimited liability — the owner's personal assets are at risk if the business fails, because there is no legal separation between owner and business.
Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness only.
The main disadvantage is that sole traders can't sell any products.

mcqs.q: Why are hygiene factors and motivators not on the same scale in Herzberg's theory?
options: Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness only.

Hygiene factors only prevent dissatisfaction (their absence demotivates, presence is neutral); motivators create satisfaction (their presence motivates, absence is neutral). They affect different outcomes, not different points on one scale.
The four Ps are Planning, Producing, Promoting, and Profit.
Hygiene factors and motivators are just two types of motivation that combine.

mcqs.q: What are the four Ps of the marketing mix?
options: The four Ps are Planning, Producing, Promoting, and Profit.
Product, Price, Place (distribution), and Promotion — the controllable variables a business uses to satisfy customers and achieve objectives.
Sole traders must employ at least one other person by law.
The four Ps are Product, Price, Profit, and People.
